title: Professor theory book, hot toddy advice and Dejan's trumpet lesson
summary: They recall a teacher's handwritten theory book and his quarter lessons; Dejan tells of his hot-water-and-whiskey advice and being made to play at his brother's lesson.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I want to ask you... Do you... Maybe you have... Because I know if you keep saying... Do you have the theory book that Professor Shonini used to write? No, boy, I sure wish I had that.

Boy, boy... He wrote his own theory book. Yeah, that's right. And the most beautiful hand-writing piece you've ever seen in your life. Boy, you ought to see that. He wrote... And... How much I said it's a quarter. Lessons of quarter. Yeah. That's right. He enjoyed teaching people. He said he wanted to make musicians as many kids as he could. He was a male man. Yeah, he was a male carrier. And he'd come home in the evening before he'd have his dinner. He got two, three scholars. He was a scholar man. He was a wife talking about... He was a lady, let him get rid of these scholars. And he...

And I'll tell you what theory he had. He told all of us. Of course, I never took a drink. I guess I was about 21 years old before I took a drink of liquor. But he said in the morning, if a man is blowing a wind instrument, take him a hot tart in the morning. Hot tart is just hot water, no sugar, and whiskey. He said if you want to always have wind. Oh. And he was an old man. Old man. And the teeth missing. But he could take that trumpet, a little spit or fly to the side, but he'd play and show you what he wanted. Yeah. That's right.
That's right. Make that time right. I mean grab what? Man, that's right.
That's right. That's right. That's right. That's right. That's right. Sing everything you play, sing it. Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Yeah.

I'll show you what kind of fellow, my brother's taking trumpet lessons. He said, come here and sit on here. And after my brother's playing, he made me play on the trumpet. On the trumpet? Yeah. He said, I said, now you all do that. He said, show him something on the trumpet. He said, show you something on the trumpet. That's what he does. He said, I take my lesson for you, my brother's taking your lesson. Make me play on the trumpet too. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He was good for him.
